recentItems.title: AFM Republic Day Parade 2025 🇲🇹
recentItems.description:
🎥 Recap from last Saturday's Republic Day Parade, led by Major Matthew Sant, featured four Guard units, the Colour Party, and the AFM Band. Soldiers marched with precision and pride along Republic Street, making their way to the heart of the capital at St. George’s Square, Valletta. ❤️

H.E. The President of Malta, and Commander of the Armed Forces of Malta, conducted the official inspection of the Parade. Subsequently, the Armed Forces of Malta Band, under the direction of Band Master Major Jonathan Borg, delivered a captivating Band display. 🎼

The Parade then proceeded with a march past in slow and quick time, performed a ceremonial Feu-de-Joie, and concluded with the playing of the National Anthem. 🇲🇹
